final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and expressly conceded the core evidentiary gaps. The response is a reinterpretation and narrowing of the same record, not proof that the policy conditions for a material limitation have been satisfied. Aggregate readiness, no severity-one rehearsal incidents, and public guidance on measurement and documentation support a monitored release posture in general, but they do not satisfy the specific policy requirement here: for a material limitation affecting a named customer-related use case, the record must show disclosure, resolution, or approved risk acceptance before launch. That proof is still missing, and legal review remains open. The distinction matters: a caveated policy-bounded position may be more defensible than an uncaveated one, but it is not enough for compliant_with_caveats when the caveat itself is an unresolved compliance predicate rather than a completed control.
